parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures the idempotence of the request.

sub_parameters.name: Code
sub_parameters.description: The code configuration for the Nth module property. The value of N can be an integer from 1 to 100. If you have multiple module properties, create a separate parameter for each by setting n to 1, 2, 3, and so on.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value configuration for the nth module property. The value of n ranges from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The product code. To obtain it, call **QueryProductList**.

parameters.name: RenewPeriod
parameters.description:
The subscription renewal duration, in months. Valid values:

- 1-9

- 12

- 24

- 36
